card.name: Comma after first listed symptom
card.fires_on: The comma right after the first or second symptom (anorexia, headache, fatigue) in a list of signs and symptoms of an electrolyte problem such as hyponatremia, hypercalcemia or hypophosphatemia.

modes.label: Hypercalcemia symptom lists
modes.description: Comma after anorexia in vitamin D toxicity or high calcium symptom lists.
modes.example: Signs and symptoms of vitamin D toxicity include hypercalcemia, hypercalciuria, anorexia<<,>> nausea, vomiting, polyuria, poly

modes.label: Hyponatremia or hypophosphatemia lists
modes.description: Comma after headache or fatigue at the start of a symptom list for low sodium or low phosphate.
modes.example: Signs and symptoms of hyponatremia include headache<<,>> difficulty concentrating, memory impairment, confusion,

card.writes: It seems to push the next item toward another general symptom such as sleepiness, sadness or fatigue.
card.plain: It marks the comma after an early symptom in a list of electrolyte-imbalance symptoms, where another vague symptom is expected next.
